author: Arasael
quote: What the hell happened to GTA? Where's the madness, dark humour and memorable characters? Instead, we get Jason, possibly the blandest protagonist Rockstar has ever created, running around trying to keep Lucia happy. Feels more like a boyfriend simulator than **** the performance on base PS5 is an absolute joke. Drops to 20 FPS, horrendous TAA, shimmering, extreme depth of field and so much blur it looks like someone smeared Vaseline across the screen. Even turning motion blur off does nothing.I've played games since the PS1 and never had a game make me physically sick until this one. Actual dizziness and headaches.Boring characters, painfully slow story, terrible image quality and zero personality. Years of waiting for this?How this gets 10/10 reviews is beyond me.
